To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
our proposed online translation approach can effectively translate unknown queries for cross-language Web retrieval.

(i) we propose an online approach to mine the Web for bilingual search-result pages, and then extract translation candidates of query terms from these bilingual search-result pages; (ii) we propose to utilize a query expansion technique to improve the effectiveness of the extracted translation candidates; (iii) our experiments show that the proposed approach is effective for cross-language Web retrieval.

(1) the proposed approach can effectively translate unknown query terms for CLIR tasks; (2) the proposed approach is able to translate many query terms; (3) the proposed approach provides flexible query specifications; and (4) the proposed approach extracts semantically-close translations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: (i) How can we translate unknown query terms via the Web?
the following three issues: (1) How to mine effective translations from the Web for cross-language Web retrieval?

two issues: (1) how to extract bilingual information from Web search results and how to translate unknown query terms based on such information; and (2) how to use the extracted bilingual information for CLIR tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach has shown promising results in translating unknown queries for CL-IR tasks.
the approach proposed in this paper can be applied to translate unknown queries with high precision for CLIR.
our approach can effectively translate unknown queries for cross-language Web retrieval, especially for the case of short queries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can effectively use the Web for the translation of unknown query terms to benefit CLIR.
our online translation approach is feasible and effective in translating unknown queries for CL IR.
our proposed online translation approach is effective for translating unknown queries for cross-language Web retrieval.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the Web can be used as a corpus source to translate many unknown query words, and that the translation quality is comparable to the baseline translation system, even though the baseline system uses large bilingual corpora.
the Web can be exploited as a source to translate unknown query terms for CLIR.
we can translate unknown query terms with high precision using the Web.
